say:0:1029402001:0.text: Do we really have to listen to Fay, Magister...? It's like she's just playing at being a detective!
say:0:1029402001:0.source_cn: 主人，我们真的要听菲的指挥吗……感觉她只是在玩侦探游戏而已！

say:1:1029402002:0.text: There's a lot going on behind all this. Let's go along with Fay for now.
